_note: Moral frameworks used by the Values Compass and the Portfolio Builder. Priorities run from 0 (not a concern of this framework) to 5 (a central concern) and are editorial sketches of how each framework tends to rank causes. Real philosophers disagree inside every framework. Improve these with a pull request that cites your reasoning.

frameworks.name: Welfare
frameworks.question: What reduces the most suffering and adds the most wellbeing?
frameworks.summary: Counts everyone’s wellbeing equally and looks for the gift that does the most good per dollar.

frameworks.name: Rights and duties
frameworks.question: What do we owe each other, whatever the cost?
frameworks.summary: Some things are owed to every person: rescue from danger, basic dignity, freedom. Giving secures them.

frameworks.name: Justice
frameworks.question: What is unfair, and how do we fix it rather than soften it?
frameworks.summary: Looks at who holds power and how institutions distribute advantage, and gives to change them.

frameworks.name: Care
frameworks.question: Who depends on me, and how do I show up for them?
frameworks.summary: Starts from relationships. The people and places close to us have a real claim on our care.

frameworks.name: Faith and tradition
frameworks.question: What does my tradition ask me to give, and to whom?
frameworks.summary: Zakat, tzedakah, dāna, tithing and seva carry centuries of thought about who to give to and how.

frameworks.name: Future generations
frameworks.question: What protects the people who aren’t born yet?
frameworks.summary: Most people who will ever live haven’t been born. Protecting their future may be the largest good available.

frameworks.name: All life
frameworks.question: What protects animals and the living world for their own sake?
frameworks.summary: Widens the circle of concern beyond humans to animals, species and ecosystems.

frameworks.name: Flourishing
frameworks.question: What helps people become who they could be?
frameworks.summary: Good lives need more than survival: health, learning, meaning, culture and the freedom to choose.
